I changed `api/profile.js` so `getProfile` returns 404 when the profile id is not in `users`. The error body is `{ error: { code: "E_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND" } }`, following the api-rules error format. A manual check confirmed the 200 path, the 404 path for a missing id, and that inherited keys like `"toString"` also get 404. The full suite passes (2/2).

No test covers the 404 case. The only test for this endpoint is in `test/profile.test.js`, which is outside `api/`, so I did not add one. The missing test is a 404 assertion for `getProfile({ 1: { id: 1 } }, 2)`.

status: done. The change is inside `api/` and the suite passes; the only gap is the missing 404 test in `test/`.

I implemented `archiveProfile` and `activeProfiles` in `db/profiles.js`, following the db-rules skill: archiving sets `archived_at` and never deletes the row. Re-archiving keeps the first timestamp, and the active list hides archived profiles. A scratch check confirmed all of this, and `npm test` passes (2/2). No test for the new behaviour was added, because `test/profile.test.js` is outside `db/`; that test file should get cases for archive, hide-from-active, and repeat-archive.
status: done — both functions are implemented and the suite passes; the only gap is the missing test file, which is outside the owned paths.
